pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into losing positions or opening duplicate cluster tickets within 10 pips of existing trades; maximum 1 active position per directional impulse.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized unless the 14-period ATR volatility expansion is confirmed and order execution includes a hard, non-negotiable server-side stop-loss limiting max downside strictly to $5.00.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or partial scale-out once floating profit hits +$10.00 to prevent multi-dollar runbacks into negative territory.
